info.name: DoorDash Drive Classic Addresses Deliveries API

items.docs: Requests time and fee estimates for a delivery. Can also be used to check if an area is serviced by DoorDash. Time values must be provided in UTC ISO-8601 format.
Creates a new delivery request. DoorDash will assign a Dasher to fulfill the delivery. Time values must be provided in UTC format. The API recommends up to 3 retries with exponential backoff.
